Agroha Archaeological Landscape

A day trip from Delhi to Agroha, Haryana

On request

Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and starting point. We prepare a day-by-day itinerary and a quotation, and revise both until they suit you. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this day you interpret an excavated site through chronology and local memory.

Transport from Delhi, the start time, meals and pace are arranged with you, and the quotation states exactly what is included.

What it covers

  • Agroha landscape orientation
  • Publicly accessible mound viewpoint
  • Evidence exercise
  • Wrap-up

How the time is spent

  1. Agroha landscape orientation 25 min

    Show published excavation history and phases.

    You: research map

  2. Publicly accessible mound viewpoint 35 min

    Explain how archaeologists infer occupation.

    You: stratigraphy diagram

  3. Evidence exercise 35 min

    Examine published pottery/coins images.

    You: identify uncertainty

  4. Wrap-up 25 min

    Compare archaeological and local sacred significance respectfully.

    You: evidence/meaning matrix

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Situate Agroha Archaeological Landscape within its regional historical context.
  • Use observable topography and published evidence to test an interpretation.
  • Produce a concise field record with uncertainty clearly identified.

You take away

A field sheet comparing what you saw.
